candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call receives all common inputs and emits one complete executable policy state. Each later call consumes the immediately preceding complete artifact, directly receives all common inputs, and re-grounds the same single policy lineage without branching or hierarchical veto. The last call emits the resulting complete policy.
candidate_structure.name: Full-Evidence Executable Re-entry Spine
candidate_structure.organization: three-call sequential lineage with two coequal executable-state transitions and no adjudicative veto tier

calls.objective: Reconcile all visible evidence and obligations directly into one complete executable policy state without creating a separate admissibility boundary.
Consume instantiate_complete_state, reconsider the full common evidence against the carried commitments, and emit the same single lineage as one complete executable policy state.
Consume reground_complete_state, reconcile the complete carried artifact once more with all common evidence, and emit one complete policy without invoking an upstream veto hierarchy.

mode_certificate.forbidden_inherited_mechanism: binding exclusion authority on a non-policy analysis handoff
mode_certificate.independent_replacement_principle: One complete executable artifact remains continuously present and is coequally re-grounded from the full common evidence at every lineage transition.
rejected_assumptions: A pre-policy analysis must bind construction through exclusions.
Only the terminal call should possess positive policy authority.
A complete executable policy need not exist before the final call.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Replace the analysis-to-policy handoff with coequal full-evidence re-entry across one continuously executable, two-edge lineage.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: Maintaining and re-grounding one complete executable artifact throughout the lineage should improve scan-response stability and phase-shift adaptation coherence without terminal reinterpretation of upstream exclusions.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The incumbent delays executable policy identity until a terminal constructor interprets a binding negative analysis, leaving coupled behavioral commitments unresolved during the sole handoff.

structural_mutation.after: The first call emits one complete executable policy state, and two successive full-evidence calls coequally re-ground that same artifact before the last emits one policy.
structural_mutation.before: One binding negative-authority analysis edge precedes a terminal call that constructs the policy with reopened common evidence.
structural_mutation.factor: coequal full-evidence re-entry across a two-edge continuously executable lineage
structural_mutation.why_structural: The single re-entry factor changes the graph from one non-policy edge to two executable-state edges and makes artifact-preserving transitions, rather than an exclusion boundary or terminal sovereignty, the locus of control.
